question: Should ClawHub standardize new skill display names at 40 characters while grandfathering existing over-limit hosted and GitHub-backed names?
rationale: The linked issue requests concise titles but leaves the exact maximum and legacy behavior undefined, and this PR chooses both policy details across stored catalog data.

options.title: Accept 40 with repaired grandfathering
